name: World Import
description: Import worlds with version compat note + unzip -o {{args}} -d world/ + write_file guard (isDangerousPath) + list_files world/.
content_html:
World Import

Version Compatibility

Worlds from 1.13+ use flattened chunk format; 1.18+ expanded height to -64…320 and 1.20+ added biomes. Importing a newer world into an older server jar can corrupt chunks — always back up world/ and match jar version. This page list_files world/ and runs unzip -o {{args}} -d world/ (validActionArg + shellQuoteArg) and guards host writes with isDangerousPath.
